services.desc: Savoy Automobile Museum aims to connect people to the cultural diversity of the automobile. So, whether you are a serious car collector, an automobile enthusiast, or someone just curious about cars, you are invited to pause for a moment and take in the artistic beauty of the magnificent machines found inside. Open Tuesday - Sunday from 10:00 am - 5:00 pm. Savoy Automobile Museum sits on a 37 acre campus. It consists of three buildings: the museum, the Vehicle Storage Building, and the outdoor Pavilion (coming soon). services.name: School Programs
services.desc: Savoy Automobile Museum offers engaging field trips and educational programs for both school groups and homeschool families. Through guided tours and hands-on activities, students explore automotive history, design, and innovation in a fun, inspiring setting. Join us for a journey that sparks curiosity and connects learning to the real world! Field trips are a powerful extension of classroom teaching. Through engaging presentations, demonstrations, and interactive tour experiences, students can deepen their understanding and broaden their awareness of the subject matter. services.desc: Savoy Automobile Museum is a beautifully appointed facility and grounds just a short drive from Atlanta in scenic North Georgia. As guests cruise down Savoy Lane, the museum’s signature bold red color, with its metal accents, and protruding curved exterior walls, are reflective of the features of many of the vehicles found inside. The landscaping design of Savoy replicates the experience of a Concours d’Elegance, a highly distinguished car show. Rolling berms, native trees and hedges decorate the lawn. blurb: Savoy Automobile Museum connects people to the cultural diversity of the automobile. Through changing exhibits, educational programs, and engaging experiences individuals have the opportunity to appreciate the beauty and history of automobiles. This world-class museum and showgrounds sits on approximately 37 acres in Cartersville, GA just off I-75, between Chattanooga and Atlanta.
